subject: FY25 School Department Budget
overview: The Committee of the Whole held its seventh preliminary FY25 budget meeting to review requests for the Health Department, Medford Public Schools, and the Department of Planning, Development, and Sustainability. The session focused largely on the school district's request and structural deficit, but took no formal binding votes on appropriations.

items.title: Paper 24-045: Health Department and Animal Control Budget
items.summary: Director MaryAnn O'Connor reviewed the proposed $806,186 budget for the Board of Health and Animal Control, highlighting incoming hires, grant funding for outreach and climate resiliency, and ongoing rodent control efforts.

items.title: Paper 24-045: Civil Defense Budget
items.summary: Director O'Connor reviewed the proposed $9,840 Civil Defense budget, noting regional emergency planning dues and exploratory discussions regarding the Medical Reserve Corps.

items.title: Paper 24-045: Medford Public Schools Budget Presentation and Discussion
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent and Finance Director Gerry McCue presented the School Committee's level-service request of $79,399,774, prompting an extended debate on potential program and staffing cuts, the expiration of ESSER funds, and the prospect of a Proposition 2 1/2 override.

items.title: Paper 24-045: Planning, Development, and Sustainability and Affiliated Boards
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt presented the proposed $812,898 budget for Planning, Development, and Sustainability along with affiliated regulatory boards and commissions, detailing grant-funded climate planning positions, intern staffing, and board stipends.
